  - Deep clean the toilet.

  - Use a bathroom cleaning schedule.
  - Keep clutter under control.
  - Use a microfiber cloth.
- [EVENT] User has been weighing themselves every morning since getting the new scale.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on their weight loss progress and provided advice on keeping the bathroom scale clean and accurate, including:
  - Wipe it down regularly.
  - Use a gentle cleaning solution.
  - Avoid harsh chemicals.
  - Place the scale on a flat surface.
  - Avoid placing objects on the scale.
  - Calibrate the scale if necessary.
  - Use the scale on a hard floor.
  - Step on the scale correctly.
- [EVENT] User organized their bathroom cabinet above the sink last Thursday.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided advice on how to best store and organize medications and skincare products in the bathroom cabinet, including:
  - Purge expired or unused medications.
  - Store medications in their original packaging.
  - Use a medication organizer.
  - Keep medications out of reach of children and pets.
  - Categorize and group similar skincare products.
  - Use a skincare organizer or tray.
  - Store products by expiration date.
